description: This Java class implements the '<store-list>' element of the mini-language used within the Apache OFBiz framework. The class provides functionality to store a list of entity values into the database via a delegator, with validation and error handling. It also includes a factory for creating instances of the '<store-list>' operation.

classes.name: StoreList
classes.description: Implements the '<store-list>' element for storing a list of entity values into the database, with validation, error handling, and custom string representation.

classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of StoreList, giving it a name for referencing in the mini-language.
